## Linked work

- GoEF issue, wave parent and dependencies
- Objective, scope and affected contracts
- Feature/operator IDs, error IDs and Gherkin scenario IDs
- Pinned upstream API, implementation and test links
- Provider/driver versions, capabilities and documentation MCP sources if applicable

## Verification

- Baseline and tested SHA
- RED or characterization, GREEN, and integrated gate results
- Exact commands, exit codes, versions and redacted evidence links
- Skipped or blocked checks, unsupported cases and next action

## Documentation and risk

- English Godoc, user guides, examples, parity and errors, affected Skills and changelog
- Compatibility, security and migration impact, including preservation and recovery evidence where relevant
- Independent review and unresolved findings

Mark inapplicable fields with a reason. Keep private data and credentials out of the pull request. Use a regular issue link while acceptance or authorized publication is pending.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The linked issue and scope match the diff and evidence.
- [ ] Applicable Gherkin scenarios, provider cells and error records are linked to executable tests.
- [ ] Guides, examples and Skills match the tested contract, or documentation impact is justified.
- [ ] Required gates are verified at the integrated SHA or blockers are recorded.
